messages:
Alex H: Heads up — noticed a bunch of spans dropping when requests go through gateway -> async queue -> worker. Traces show the gateway span but the worker starts a new trace. Anyone else?

Maya P: yep, saw that on prod last night. Looks like `traceparent` header isn't being set on messages. We're using SNS -> SQS -> worker.

Jordan L: SNS/SQS don't preserve HTTP headers. We currently serialize body only. Need to attach `traceparent` as message attribute (or embed in payload).

Alex H: Options: a) Add trace headers as message attributes b) embed in JSON envelope c) use OTEL link semantics to link spans from gateway to worker (worker creates child from context if present).

Samir: Linking is preferable semantically for async jobs, but requires we capture parent span id and trace id and add as a link. OTEL supports span links, e.g., `SpanBuilder.addLink(traceId, spanId)`.

Maya P: Concern: message attributes increase message size and there are limits (SQS has attribute limits). Need to verify exact limits; also tracestate can get long.

Jordan L: Implementation detail in Go: use W3C propagation. Example: `prop := propagation.TraceContext{}` then `prop.Inject(ctx, carrier)` where carrier implements `TextMapCarrier` backed by message attributes.

Alex H: Pseudocode: ```go
// publisher
carrier := sqsCarrier{}
prop.Inject(ctx, &carrier)
attrs := carrier.ToAttributes()
client.SendMessage(&sqs.SendMessageInput{MessageBody: body, MessageAttributes: attrs})
```

Maya P: On the worker: if attrs present, do `prop.Extract(ctx, &carrier)` then `tracer.Start(ctx, "process-task")` to create a child span. If no attrs, start a new root span.

Samir: Also we should set a sampling decision at publish time so workers don't accidentally sample a ton. Maybe attach a `x-sampling-priority` or include it in `tracestate`.

Jordan L: Alternative minimal approach: attach `x-request-id` / `redwood-id` for logs to correlate, then later backfill traces. But OTEL `traceparent` is better for full trace continuity.

Alex H: Retry behavior matters — if a job is retried and we start a new child span each attempt, the UI will show multiple attempts. Maybe include original trace id as a link or attribute `original_trace_id` so tooling can stitch attempts.

Maya P: Proposed plan: 1) inject `traceparent` + `tracestate` into message attributes when publishing, 2) on worker `Extract` and either StartWithParent or StartWithLink depending on job semantics, 3) set export service.name to `worker.<queue>` so traces are searchable by queue.

Jordan L: Also update OTLP exporter batching to respect resource attributes and avoid exploding token/ingest costs. We should add a sampling policy per queue (low prob for bulk background jobs).

Samir: :thumbsup: I'll spike an SQS message-attribute carrier in the shared pubsub lib and add unit tests for inject/extract and for linking vs child behavior. Will also open an RFC for queue-level sampling defaults.

Alex H: Thanks — could you add a short Console docs snippet so support can enable tracing for specific queues/routes? Ops would appreciate a simple on/off toggle + sampling slider.

Samir: Yep, I'll add docs + a basic Jaeger dashboard template for async traces. I'll post the spike PR later today and ping here.

Maya P: Awesome — once we have a patch, let's run a small end-to-end test: create a request that publishes a task, wait for worker span, verify `trace_id` continuity and check links for retries.

Jordan L: I'll help with the test harness (localstack + otel collector).

Samir: thanks everyone. I'll include notes about header length/tracestate truncation and fallback to embedding payload if attributes are rejected.
